title: NEXT F API Contract Registry
description: Authoritative API surfaces, common request/response contracts and operation policies for NEXT F-integrated Sites.

categories.label: Envelopes & Errors
categories.description: Canonical success/error envelopes, request metadata and validation issues.

categories.label: Query & Collections
categories.description: Pagination, filtering, sorting, searching, includes and field selection.

categories.label: Security & Authorization
categories.description: Authentication context, permission requirements and tenant/request scope.

categories.label: Mutation Integrity
categories.description: Idempotency, optimistic concurrency and command result semantics.

categories.label: Delivery & Runtime
categories.description: Caching, versioning, localization, rate limits, CORS and health.

categories.label: Files & Uploads
categories.description: Controlled file upload session and completion contracts.

categories.label: Operations & Bulk
categories.description: Operation references, bulk execution and deletion semantics.

authModes.label: Anonymous
authModes.description: No authenticated identity. Still subject to origin, abuse, module and data policies.

authModes.label: Anonymous or Commerce Customer
authModes.description: May use an anonymous cart/session or an authenticated Commerce Customer context.

authModes.label: Organization User
authModes.description: Authenticated Customer CMS user scoped through Phase 15 authorization.

authModes.label: NEXT F Admin
authModes.description: Authenticated NEXT F internal principal with platform authorization.

authModes.label: Commerce Customer
authModes.description: Authenticated storefront customer; never equivalent to an Organization User.

authModes.label: Site Server
authModes.description: Trusted server-to-server Site integration identity. Browser use is prohibited.

authModes.label: Internal Service
authModes.description: NEXT F trusted service identity for internal processing only.

authModes.label: Preview Grant
authModes.description: Short-lived scoped grant for unpublished preview content only.

cachePolicies.label: Public Edge Cache
cachePolicies.description: Public published GET responses may be cached by shared edge caches with explicit validators.

cachePolicies.label: Public Short Cache
cachePolicies.description: Short-lived public cache for rapidly changing but non-personal data.

cachePolicies.label: Private Revalidation
cachePolicies.description: Private browser/client cache only; shared caches prohibited.

cachePolicies.label: No Store
cachePolicies.description: Response must not be cached because it is a mutation, sensitive, personal or operational response.

rateLimitClasses.label: Public Read
rateLimitClasses.description: High-volume read traffic with Site-level abuse controls.

rateLimitClasses.label: Public Write
rateLimitClasses.description: Strict anonymous write protection for forms/search-like interactions.

rateLimitClasses.label: Sensitive Write
rateLimitClasses.description: Low-volume sensitive or destructive operation budget with stronger controls.

rateLimitClasses.label: Commerce Checkout
rateLimitClasses.description: Checkout/cart transactional traffic with anti-abuse and idempotency controls.

rateLimitClasses.label: Server to Server
rateLimitClasses.description: Trusted integration/event traffic with identity-specific quotas.

corsPolicies.label: Public Read Origins
corsPolicies.description: GET/HEAD public content may be exposed according to configured Site origin policy.

corsPolicies.label: Site Origin
corsPolicies.description: Browser requests restricted to configured Site origins; CORS is not authorization.

corsPolicies.label: Customer Portal
corsPolicies.description: Customer CMS origins only, with authenticated session/CSRF protections.

errorCodes.description: Malformed request or invalid request shape.
One or more supplied values failed canonical validation.
Authentication is required or invalid.
Authenticated principal lacks required authorization.
Requested resource is not available in the caller scope.
HTTP method is not supported for the resource.
Request conflicts with current authoritative state.
Required concurrency precondition was not supplied.
Supplied concurrency precondition does not match current state.
Caller exceeded an applicable rate or abuse-control budget.
Request payload exceeds the permitted size.
Request media type is unsupported.
Operation requires an idempotency key.
Idempotency key was previously used for a different request fingerprint.
Requested NEXT F Contract Version is unsupported.
Requested API version is unsupported.
Required Site module is disabled.
Required module capability is disabled.
Resource does not belong to the authorized tenant/Site scope.
Resource is temporarily locked from mutation.
Requested state transition is not allowed.
Operation would violate an authoritative domain invariant.
A resource with the relevant unique identity already exists.
Pagination cursor is invalid, expired or incompatible.
Filter contains an unsupported field/operator/value.
Sort field or direction is unsupported.
Requested include/expansion is not allow-listed.
Requested sparse field selection is invalid.
Preview grant is invalid, expired or outside its scope.
Upload session is invalid, expired or already finalized.
Uploaded file failed type, size, integrity or security checks.
Public interaction was rejected by anti-abuse policy.
Requested inventory operation conflicts with authoritative stock/reservations.
Payment-provider or payment-state operation failed.
Requested refund exceeds refundable captured amount.
Webhook endpoint must be verified before use.
Webhook delivery is outside redelivery policy.
Canonical Event is not eligible for the requested external exposure.
Unexpected internal failure. Public message must remain non-sensitive.
Required service is temporarily unavailable.
Upstream dependency did not respond within the allowed timeout.

groups.name: Public Content API
groups.description: Read-only delivery of published public content. Drafts, secrets, Admin metadata and private records are excluded.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: Public Interaction API
groups.description: Strict public write/read interactions such as form submission and public site search. Kept separate from Public Content so published delivery stays read-only.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: Customer CMS API
groups.description: Authenticated customer Site Workspace API for structured content, SEO, media, forms, leads and publishing.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: NEXT F Admin API
groups.description: Privileged NEXT F platform operations for Organizations, Sites, modules, compatibility, integrations, diagnostics and audit.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: Commerce API
groups.description: Storefront and authorized commerce-management operations governed by Commerce Core and Commerce Rules.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: Event API
groups.description: Canonical Event observation/inspection APIs plus sanitized tracking ingestion. External clients cannot inject authoritative Phase 13 domain Events.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

groups.name: Webhook Management API
groups.description: Webhook endpoint, subscription, delivery and redelivery management. Distinct from the Phase 14 outbound receiver/signature protocol.
boundaries: Uses canonical NEXT F Contract Registry schemas rather than redefining domain entities.
Secrets and privileged credentials are never returned through generic API responses.
API Version and NEXT F Contract Version are independently explicit.

boundaries: Public Content API is strictly read-only.
Public writes use Public Interaction API.
API authentication never replaces Phase 15 authorization.
Canonical Phase 13 domain Events cannot be injected by public/external clients.
Commerce mutations remain governed by Phase 12 Commerce Rules.
Webhook Management API is separate from the Phase 14 outbound webhook delivery protocol.
